claim: For balanced step words with small step size, the holonomy of any noncommuting generator pair carries the path's signed area (held-out R2 > 0.99 from one linear readout); commuting generators carry none.
limits: One task family, length 40, one readout, x86_64 only. The same area is computed exactly and far more cheaply by the shoelace formula (E6): no advantage.
